summary: Loads a font resource for the UI: frees any existing resource at this+0xE4, builds the font path from the directory string at this+0xB0, the base directory dword_5EC3F0 and the font name at this+0xB8 (each falling back to byte_5EA438), creates the resource via ObjectCreationWithRollbackOnFailure with the accumulated path, clears the metric fields at this+0xE8/this+0xEC, and on the failure branch clears the active byte at this+0xF8, copies the glyph width/height from the created object into this+0xF0/this+0xF4, and configures a DSP parameter via sub_551EB0(flt_7CF2CC). Returns 1 on success, 0 otherwise.

operations.description: If the resource pointer at this+0xE4 is non-zero, release it via ConditionalFreeWithBinkClose.
Copy the font directory path string at this+0xB0 (falling back to byte_5EA438 when null) via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
Allocate a 128-byte path buffer via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and clear its first byte.
Copy the base directory dword_5EC3F0 (or the byte_5EA438 fallback) via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc.
Append the font name string at this+0xB8 (or the byte_5EA438 fallback) via sub_5665B0.
Create the font resource object via ObjectCreationWithRollbackOnFailure, passing the accumulated path buffer (or the byte_5EA438 fallback) and writing the result through the this+0xE4 slot.
Clear the metric fields at this+0xEC and this+0xE8 to 0.
On creation success, clear the resource pointer at this+0xE4 and set the success flag (return 1).

On creation failure, clear the active byte at this+0xF8; when a resource object is still present at this+0xE4, copy the glyph width from its +0xC into this+0xF0 and the glyph height from its +0x10 into this+0xF4.
On the failure branch with a resource object present, configure the DSP parameter via sub_551EB0(flt_7CF2CC).
Free the 128-byte path buffer via FreeWrapper_7bcf when it was allocated.
Return the success flag (1 when the resource was created, 0 otherwise).

unresolved: The contract of ObjectCreationWithRollbackOnFailure is unclear: the glyph metrics are read from the resource object on the failure branch, which suggests partial creation on failure.
The meaning of the DSP parameter configured by sub_551EB0(flt_7CF2CC) is unknown.
The roles of the metric fields this+0xF0/this+0xF4 and the active byte at this+0xF8 (beyond being cleared) are not established by this packet.
The exact path concatenation contract between StringCopyWithBufferRealloc and sub_5665B0 is not established; they may append into separate buffers.
